purpose: Unassisted proof: Frontier -> VOS -> local free worker -> independent Judge -> GitHub PR -> Frontier
source_ref: Owner-approved shadow test, ChatGPT conversation on 2026-11-08
objective: A genuinely local, free coding worker—not ChatGPT—must implement inventory_delta.py in an isolated disposable workspace. It must expose inventory_changes(before_csv: str, after_csv: str) -> dict using only Python 3.8+ standard library. Each CSV has the exact header sku,quantity. Strip ASCII whitespace around SKUs, uppercase ASCII SKUs, and parse non-negative base-10 integer quantities. Reject empty SKUs, duplicates after normalization, extra or missing columns, invalid integers, and malformed CSV with ValueError. Return {'changes': [{'sku': S, 'before': B, 'after': A, 'delta': A-B}, ...]}, sorted by sku, including only nonzero deltas; missing SKUs mean quantity 0. No filesystem, shell, network, secret, or production effects from the submitted function.
acceptance_criteria: A genuine locally executed model, identified by model digest, generates the source patch without ChatGPT supplying implementation code.
The exact starting git SHA and all changed blob SHA values are recorded; no protected path changes.
An independent deterministic Judge executes its own tests on real original worker output; positive normal cases and malformed/duplicate/negative cases are covered.
The Judge proves it rejects at least one independently mutated or deliberately incorrect candidate and records the negative test result.
VOS records immutable task identity, worker and Judge receipts, bounded retries, and no duplicate execution after replay/restart.
Only after deterministic verification may a GitHub draft PR containing the worker-generated patch be opened; neither merge nor deploy is allowed.
A separate Frontier review reads the actual PR and Judge evidence without owner copy/paste and issues a documented decision.
Additional paid/API cost is exactly 0; quotas, runtime or billing uncertainty fail closed.
explicitly_denied: GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch of existing G0-SHADOW SPEC-001
Automatic merge, release, deploy, production restart, external messages, credential disclosure
GitHub-hosted worker substituted for a physical/local worker
Assistant-produced implementation patch substituted for local-model output
Declaring PASS based on static review, simulated Judge, mocked hardware, or unverified provider/model claims
evidence_policy: UNKNOWN/NOT_RUN/STOP until physical execution and exact readback. This file is a challenge, NOT a VOS-accepted mandate and NOT an Owner-signed authority.
